source_text: Περὶ τοῦ μὴ συγχωρεῖν τοῖς αἱρετικοῖς εἰσιέναι εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἐπιμένοντας τῇ αἱρέσει. Ἐ ρ μ η ν ε ί α. Ὁ διορισμὸς τοῦ παρόντος Κανόνος εἶναι, νά μὴ ἔχουν τὴν ἄδειαν οἱ αἱρετικοὶ νά ἐμβαίνουν μέσα εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ, τὸν ὑπὸ ὀρθοδόξων κρατούμενον, ἐὰν ἐπιμένουν εἰς τὴν αἵρεσιν, καὶ δέν θέλουν νά ἐπιστραφοῦν. Ἀνάγνωθι καὶ τὸν με΄. Ἀποστολικόν.
thought_title: Heretics barred from the church building while persisting in heresy
orientation: The Council of Laodicea is issuing its sixth canon, now forbidding heretics who persist in their heresy from entering the church building held by the orthodox.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning the not [to] permit [to] the heretics [to] enter into the house [of] God, [while] persisting in the heresy. I n t e r p r e t a t i o n. The determination [of] the present Canon is, that not [to] have the permission the heretics [to] go in inside into the temple [of] God, the by [the] orthodox held, if they persist in the heresy, and not they want [to] be converted. Read also the 45th Apostolic [Canon].

choices.why: Literal rendering of the source phrase, preserving the building metaphor.
The interpretation uses ναός rather than οἶκος; rendering it as 'temple' preserves the distinction in the source.
The participle carries a conditional force ('if they persist'), which the interpretation makes explicit; the gloss keeps the participial force.
The verb means to turn back or be converted; 'return' is the plain literal sense here.
Literal rendering of the passive participle with the agent expressed by ὑπό.

pass_b_english: Concerning the rule that heretics are not to be permitted to enter the house of God while persisting in the heresy. Interpretation. The decree of the present Canon is that heretics are not to have permission to enter the temple of God, the one held by orthodox, if they persist in the heresy and do not wish to return. See also Apostolic Canon 45.
